title: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts, RAG templates, and docs site updates
author: Ava Martinez
description: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and site docs updates to make it straightforward for developers to get started with agents and tool integrations. Motivation: developers repeatedly ask for end-to-end, runnable examples that demonstrate tool calling, RAG templates, and prompt scaffolding for common workflows (search + tool invocation + structured output). This PR introduces three new quickstarts (python, typescript, and a self-hosted example), a library of RAG templates for common patterns, updated docs pages with step-by-step walkthroughs, and a few small improvements to the examples site to support live demos. Checklist: add quickstart examples and README; add RAG template YAMLs and reference docs; update docs site navigation and code snippets; add CI smoke tests for examples; include migration notes for existing agent templates. Testing: local smoke runs, CI examples build, docs site preview passes. Related: ENG-4321, PM-1102. This description bundles context, changes, testing notes and migration guidance into a single continuous string as required.
